# Rockbase

> Rockbase builds websites, automates back-office work, and runs social media
> marketing for businesses that need a partner who ships.

## Services

- Web Development — Next.js / React marketing sites and web apps.
- Robotic Process Automation — automating repetitive back-office work.
- Social Media Marketing — content strategy, platform management, paid campaigns.
